name: Tamaclaw
description: Companion display: the agent's animated face. Speak out loud, show notifications, dashboard charts and moods on the kiosk screen. Installing this plugin also runs the bridge + display server.

port.description: Port for the embedded bridge/display server (default 4321).

startBridge.description: Run the bridge inside the gateway (default true). Set false if you run it standalone.

bridgeUrl.description: Base URL of the Tamaclaw bridge (default http://127.0.0.1:<port>).

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for bridge calls in ms (default 3000).
